name: vision_metric
title: Person re-identification by metric learning: an ArcFace head, batch-hard triplets, a P x K batch sampler and a rank/AUC/mAP evaluation
origin: domain-vision round 2: the metric-learning shape, where the vision and sklearn halves meet. Its ArcFace head returns margin-adjusted LOGITS paired with nn.CrossEntropyLoss, and its roc_auc_score is fed raw cosine similarities - two pairings that look like MLV401 and MLV306 and are neither

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this project; sklearn is imported for two metrics only
nothing is fitted on anything - the metrics are pure functions
there is no cross-validator in this project
THE TRAP: the training loader takes batch_sampler=PKSampler, which owns both the batching and the shuffling - passing shuffle= alongside it raises. The documented sampler= guard covers exactly this
the query and gallery loaders are built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_transform() is Resize, ToTensor and Normalize; the flip, the pad-crop and the RandomErasing live in train_transform()
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward() every batch
backward() precedes clip_grad_norm_() which precedes step()
the two no_grad regions are extract() and rank(), neither of which contains a backward()
the running loss accumulates loss.item(), and the embeddings are collected under @torch.no_grad()
OneCycleLR is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() runs inside the batch loop
clip_grad_norm_ runs between backward() and step()
extract() calls model.eval() before the loop and rank() calls model.train() on the way out
both extract() and rank() carry the @torch.no_grad() decorator

THE TRAP: roc_auc_score and average_precision_score are in the documented score-metric carve-out - a cosine similarity is exactly what they take. The rank-1 accuracy is computed from similarity.argmax(dim=1), which decides before it compares
THE SECOND TRAP: the score argument of roc_auc_score is the raw similarity matrix, not a hard prediction. That is the correct input, and it is what the rule exists to ask for

THE THIRD TRAP: ArcFace.forward returns scale * (margin-adjusted cosine), i.e. logits, and CombinedObjective pairs it with nn.CrossEntropyLoss. The margin lives in the head; there is no softmax anywhere in this workspace
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the model and the objective are both moved with .to(device) and every batch tensor is moved inside every loop
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda, and PKSampler takes its own seeded random.Random
there is no split in this project - train/, query/ and gallery/ are separate directories
EmbeddingNet, ArcFace, BatchHardTripletLoss and CombinedObjective all call super().__init__() first
PKSampler calls super().__init__(None), which is torch.utils.data.Sampler's signature
there is no plain list or dict of submodules anywhere
the checkpoint saves state_dict()s for both the trunk and the head
